reasons.overallMobile: Coherent and accessible complete mission in portrait, strong feedback and assistance, with narrow-view threat tracking and crowded control/scene space. Two assisted wins alone do not determine the grade.
reasons.controls: Labeled MOVE/FIRE drag, scene swipe and DASH registered. Tap aim helped visible patrol engagement. Edge targets and projection changes require care; continuous hold comfort and physical ergonomics unassessed.
reasons.gameplay: Recovery-to-Custodian-to-upload sequence provides clear progression; OPEN/ARMOR and damage make timing and threats visible. Much travel was assisted, and repeated route holds felt procedurally simple in this sampled mode; unaided depth and sustained enjoyment unassessed.
reasons.presentation: Rain, teal/gold lighting, industrial silhouettes, weapon and polished title/result panels form a consistent atmosphere. Software-WebGL cannot establish phone visual performance.
reasons.usability: Clear objective checkmarks, contextual HOLD APPROACH/FACE COILS, extraction map and progress bar explain next actions; multiple simultaneous warnings and controls still demand attention.
reasons.readability: High contrast HUD and large control labels worked at 390x844. Distant sentinels, small Roman coil labels, tiny map legend and text over dark moving scenery were harder; portrait limits lateral awareness.
